title: Acyclic lifts of semilinear coefficient evaluation
statement: For a small site $J$ and an inverse sequence of commutative ring sheaves $B$ with strict semilinear systems [def-coef-semilinear-system-models, lem-pur-system-ringed-sequence-site], every acyclic cochain complex $Z$ of $B_n$-modules admits an acyclic cochain complex $L$ of systems and an isomorphism $\operatorname{ev}_n(L)\cong Z$. No flatness of the ring transitions or of the terms is required.

source.place: Construction 4.1, strict semilinear systems; elementary right extension at a vertex, as detailed in the proof.

proof.text: For a B_n-module M define its system at k≥n by restriction along B_k→B_n and at k<n by zero. Above n the transition is the identity on the underlying sheaf, with the restriction-of-scalars composition isomorphism; all remaining transitions are zero. These maps satisfy identity and composition componentwise and define an additive functor. Restriction along B_n→B_n identifies its n-th evaluation with M, naturally.

Apply this functor termwise to Z. Each nonzero level complex is obtained by exact scalar restriction, hence is acyclic; all other levels are zero. Exactness of strict systems is componentwise, so the whole system complex is acyclic.

Transport the complex through the strict-system/sequence-module equivalence. The equivalence is exact, so it preserves acyclicity. Its unit, the identity scalar-restriction isomorphism at n and the sectionwise identity between sequence evaluation and semilinear evaluation give ev_n(L)≅Z.

proof_origin.place: Construction 4.1; explicit right extension at one vertex, exactness checked componentwise, zero lower prefix. B3 all-acyclic-test K-flat preservation argument.

from.place: Evaluation preserves K-flatness against every acyclic complex, without a flat-term hypothesis.

lean.statement: theorem semilinearEvaluation_acyclicLift (Z : CochainComplex (WeilConjectures.SemilinearSections.Mod J (A n)) ℤ) (hZ : Z.Acyclic) : ∃ (L : CochainComplex (WeilConjectures.SemilinearSections.Systems J A τ) ℤ), L.Acyclic ∧ Nonempty ((((WeilConjectures.SemilinearSections.evaluation J A τ n).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj L) ≅ Z)
